title: 3C Carrot or Stick? — Фразы: реакция на чужое мнение

items.example: I can see where you're coming from, but it's impractical.
On a practical level, we can't ask people to leave.
I can see the logic in that, but we don't want to cut prices.
On the other hand, some visitors need their dogs.
I see why you're suggesting a tough approach.
It might be more effective to offer a reward.
That makes sense. So what reward would you suggest?
That's quite a neat idea, but it would be expensive.
One disadvantage of that would be the high cost.
It is better to offer a reward than a punishment.

items.phrase: combine a carrot and a stick
items.example: What about combining a carrot and a stick?
We don't want to reduce prices too much.
We can't ask people to leave halfway through a film.
I think we should ban all phones from the cinema.
We should put up notices asking to switch off phones.
We could reward visitors if they switch off their phones.
